hypotheses.paper: kappa >= 0 (E_0, the extreme BTZ model, included)
hypotheses.note: alpha > 0 only ([Fact (0 < alpha)]); kappa = 0 not covered: E_0 is not constructed by the paper (its printed metric at l.1330 makes the singular line timelike, finding of an earlier wave)

hypotheses.paper: future causal / chronological curve (l.1337), undefined across the singular line
hypotheses.note: read as in CausalScaffold.Static: graph over the time axis of a 1-Lipschitz (resp. c-Lipschitz, c < 1) map into C_alpha for its metric

findings: l.1327-1329 gives the metric -dt^2+dr^2+r^2 dtheta^2 for every alpha without saying that theta runs over R/alphaZ: the angle alpha enters only through the period of theta, which the sentence should state ('theta in R/alpha Z').

For alpha > 0, E_alpha = R x C_alpha with C_alpha the Euclidean cone over the circle of length alpha, d^2 = r1^2 + r2^2 - 2 r1 r2 cos(min(delta, pi)); proper and geodesic for every alpha > 0, alpha > 2pi included (there geodesics between directions >= pi apart run through the apex and are not unique). The relations defined by curves in every open set form a causality, I^pm_U(A) open, and the singular line {r = 0} is a chronal curve in every open set containing it ('timelike, hence locally chronal', l.1341, confirmed).
The sentence 'On any E>=0-manifold there is then a unique causal structure inducing that of E_alpha in every chart' (l.1339-1341) is the (G,X) part, not addressed.
questions: l.1337: what is a future causal curve of E_alpha where it meets the singular line? Read as the graph over t of a 1-Lipschitz map into C_alpha for the cone metric (in reg(E_alpha) this is the causal cone of the metric); the paper (and [brunswic2021cauchy] as cited) leaves it implicit.

hypotheses.note: not used: for alpha > 0, J^pm(p) = closure I^pm(p) is proved directly from the static structure

findings: For alpha > 0 the proof's appeal to [brunswic2021cauchy, Section 1.2] for 'J^pm(p) is the closure of its interior' (l.1480-1482) is not needed: Z^mp(E_alpha) = E_alpha, and J^pm(p) = closure I^pm(p) follows from the vertical time shift (Static.closure_Iplus). The citation is needed only for kappa = 0.

kb_proposals: A space defined by a distance formula with identifications is cleanest as SeparationQuotient of a PseudoMetricSpace on the coordinates (Topology/MetricSpace/Basic.lean:191-203, SeparationQuotient.instMetricSpace): dist_mk is rfl, mk_eq_mk + Metric.inseparable_iff turn identification into dist = 0. Wrap it in a def with an explicit MetricSpace instance so the topology has one path.

Planar triangle inequalities with angles: write the law of cosines as ||r - s e^{ia}|| in C (Complex.norm_def, exp_ofReal_mul_I_re/_im) and the triangle inequality is norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub after one rotation.

At this pin AddCircle.norm_le_half_period and AddCircle.norm_coe_eq_abs_iff take the period EXPLICITLY (AddCircle.norm_le_half_period α hα.ne'), AddCircle.norm_eq takes it implicitly; a lemma named AddCircle.foo inside namespace Causal shadows the root AddCircle namespace (name it exists_addCircle_rep instead).
Lake's glob 'CausalScaffold.*' is andSubmodules (Lake/Config/Glob.lean:51, Name.isPrefixOf): subdirectory modules like CausalScaffold.Model.Cone are in the library.
notes: Both modules build (lake build CausalScaffold.Model.Cone CausalScaffold.Model.Massive), strict-typecheck with -DwarningAsError=true, contain no sorry, and their main declarations depend only on propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound. The lakefile glob picks up the Model/ subdirectory (andSubmodules), so the files stay under Model/. For graduation: scaffold/CausalScaffold.lean must import CausalScaffold.Model.Massive (which imports Model.Cone and Minkowski) for the axiom sweep (kb/0015 item 3); Massive.lean declares a global instance Causal.fact_two_pi_pos : Fact (0 < 2 * Real.pi) (mathlib only has a local one, Analysis/Polynomial/Fourier.lean:43). All instances are named. No label is marked: each is proved for every alpha > 0, kappa = 0 not covered. Not done: 'every non-apex point has a Euclidean-disc neighbourhood' (only the apex half of the uniqueness sanity fact, apex_not_euclidean, is proved); the identification of the distance formula with the length metric of dr^2 + r^2 dtheta^2 is argued in prose (Cone.lean SCOPE).
